# mom-plain-top20-6m-ma200 vs NIFTY 50 TRI, month by month

- Run: nifty50 2008-02-01..2025-08-31 lag1 (trading days 2008-02-01 to 2025-08-29), cost scenario base, starting capital Rs 1000000
- Strategy: stage `tax-today`, after costs and tax (today's tax rates for every year)
- Index: the same capital in the NIFTY 50 TRI on the first day, held to the end
- Last month (*): both sides carry the tax due on selling everything at the last close; for the index that is Rs 591852
- Difference is strategy % minus index %, in percentage points. Open lots are counted at the month's last close.

Whole run: strategy 150.72% (CAGR 5.37%), index 408.59% (CAGR 9.70%), CAGR difference -4.33 points. Strategy beat the index in 100 of 211 months. 305 buys, 285 sells, 20 lots open at the end.
